value.author: pi-claude
value.text: Stalled-PR recovery round 3. Root causes of the failing checks: (1) both test jobs failed test-environment's entrypoint audit because the new release-workflow contract test did not isolate before importing the SDK; fixed by importing the session isolation helper as its first statement, matching every other test entrypoint. (2) Node 22 additionally reported a one-descriptor leak in the object-lifetime soak; that test is untouched by this PR and passes locally on repeated runs, so it is treated as a pre-existing runner flake and left for CI to re-verify on the new head. (3) Greptile thread (stale self-host archive) and CodeRabbit thread (release commit carries the preparation stamp outside the bundle source) both addressed: excluded the release candidate stamp from the self-host source set and regenerated the committed bundle so tip-tree equality holds. Coverage retained: unattested-publish refusal checks and caller contracts unchanged; targeted suites 55/55 and the entrypoint audit 6/6 passed locally, plus typecheck and lint.
